products.name: Peach blossom drops
products.material: Polymer clay, freshwater pearl, gold-plated hooks
products.desc: A five-petal blossom shading from coral at the edges to cream at the centre, hung under a single freshwater pearl. Hand-painted and resin-coated for a lasting shine, with delicate pearl details.

products.name: Blush hydrangea drops
products.material: Polymer clay, freshwater pearl, gold-plated hooks
products.desc: Soft ruffled petals in the palest blush, with a textured centre. The quietest pair of the set. Hand-painted and resin-coated for a lasting shine, with delicate pearl details.

products.name: Pink blossom drops
products.material: Polymer clay, freshwater pearl, gold-plated hooks
products.desc: Deep pink at the petal edges fading to white, with a small gold-toned centre. Hand-painted and resin-coated for a lasting shine, with delicate pearl details.

products.name: Sunset blossom drops
products.material: Polymer clay, freshwater pearl, gold-plated hooks
products.desc: Pink and marigold blended into each petal, so the colour shifts depending on the light. Hand-painted and resin-coated for a lasting shine, with delicate pearl details.

products.name: Lilac blossom and leaf
products.material: Polymer clay, freshwater pearl, gold-plated hooks
products.desc: A lilac bloom with a darker centre and a sculpted green leaf beneath. The longest drop in the set. Hand-painted and resin-coated for a lasting shine, with delicate pearl details.

products.name: Blue rose and leaf
products.material: Polymer clay, freshwater pearl, gold-plated hooks
products.desc: A layered rose in dusty blue-grey with a green leaf below. Each rose is rolled petal by petal. Hand-painted and resin-coated for a lasting shine, with delicate pearl details.

products.name: Butter blossom drops
products.material: Polymer clay, freshwater pearl, gold-plated hooks
products.desc: A small warm-cream flower on a pearl. The one to wear when you want almost nothing. Hand-painted and resin-coated for a lasting shine, with delicate pearl details.

products.name: Sun charm drops
products.material: Gold-plated brass, clay centre
products.desc: A rayed sun with a speckled cream centre, on a fine hook. The only non-floral pair so far.

products.name: Lotus pond cameo
products.material: Hand-painted cabochon, oxidised silver-tone filigree
products.desc: Blossoms painted over deep green, set behind glass in a scalloped filigree frame. The largest pair in the collection.

products.name: Koi and lily cameo
products.material: Hand-painted cabochon, oxidised silver-tone filigree
products.desc: Orange koi turning between lily pads on a teal ground. Painted freehand, so the two never match exactly.

products.name: Flying birds cameo
products.material: Hand-painted cabochon, oxidised silver-tone filigree
products.desc: Birds crossing an open blue sky, brushed in a few strokes and sealed under glass.

products.name: Hillside cameo
products.material: Hand-painted cabochon, oxidised silver-tone filigree
products.desc: A small landscape on each oval: green slopes, a pale horizon, a wash of sky.

products.name: Pink heart drops
products.material: Enamelled heart, silver-tone setting
products.desc: A glossy pink heart in a slim silver frame. Comes on a drop hook or a small huggie hoop.

products.name: Opal heart drops
products.material: Enamelled heart, silver-tone setting
products.desc: Marbled white with a faint shimmer through it, so the surface shifts as it catches light.

products.name: Blue heart danglers
products.material: Enamelled heart, silver-tone setting
products.desc: Elegance in a small royal blue heart, on a huggie hoop that sits close to the lobe.

products.name: Nimbu mirchi drops
products.material: Polymer clay, gold-plated hooks
products.desc: A lemon over two green chillies, the charm people hang for luck, shrunk down to earring size. Each chilli is rolled and curved by hand.

products.name: Pressed petal heart drops
products.material: Resin with pressed petals, silver-tone setting
products.desc: Pink petals suspended in clear resin, set in a slim silver heart. No two hearts catch the light the same way.

products.name: Painted from your photo
products.material: Hand-painted miniature, sealed under gloss, gold- or silver-tone frame
products.desc: Send a photograph and it gets painted by hand onto a pair of tiny frames. This pair was made from a photo of a riverbank. Allow two to three weeks.

products.name: Breakfast Club
products.material: Polymer clay on a printed card, neodymium magnets
products.desc: A croissant, a waffle and a coffee bean, mounted on a hand-drawn cafe card. Sculpted one at a time.

products.name: Bread Basket
products.material: Polymer clay on a printed card, neodymium magnets
products.desc: A baguette, rolls and a soft-boiled egg, set against a drawn bakery basket.

products.name: Pancakes, Waffles & Butter
products.material: Polymer clay on a printed card, neodymium magnets
products.desc: A stack of pancakes, a golden waffle and a pat of butter, on a card drawn with maple syrup running down it.

products.name: Italian Edition
products.material: Polymer clay on a printed card, neodymium magnets
products.desc: A farfalle bow and a ripe tomato, against a trattoria drawn with a scooter parked outside.

products.name: Cookie Collection
products.material: Polymer clay on a printed card, neodymium magnets
products.desc: Two chocolate chip cookies, each chip pressed in by hand, on a card scattered with more of them.
